hints.label: nudge
hints.text: The database is idle but the app says it cannot get a connection. Connections are going somewhere and not coming back.

hints.label: pointer to the signal
hints.text: Print the pool's in-use count after each kind of request (found, not found, invalid input, cancelled). One kind moves the number up and it never comes down.

hints.label: near-solution
hints.text: Handlers acquire a connection and then raise or return early before releasing it. Use a context manager or try/finally for every acquire, on every path, then verify in-use returns to zero.
